an7.69:1.1: The name of the tree is _pāricchattako koviḷāro_. This is *Bauhinia variegata*, the Orchid Tree, sacred to Hindus as the _kovidāra_. In season, it has a magnificent crown of bright pink flowers.
an7.69:2.2: I follow BB’s botanical interpretation here, but use more colloquial terms. I doubt if the devas sounded like botany textbooks.
